title: Yoneda class of a pulled-back extension
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf], and Yoneda class $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$. For every morphism $u:\mathcal C'\to\mathcal C$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, the Yoneda class of the pullback short exact sequence $u^*\mathcal E$ is $\delta\circ u\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C',\mathcal A)$, using the Yoneda functoriality of [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-functoriality].

source.place: Derived Section Tag 06XP, contravariant functoriality of Ext and Yoneda composition

proof.text: Write the original maps as $i:\mathcal A\to\mathcal E$ and $p:\mathcal E\to\mathcal C$. Form the fiber product $P=\mathcal E\times_{\mathcal C}\mathcal C'$ with projections $q:P\to\mathcal E$ and $p':P\to\mathcal C'$. The maps $a\mapsto(i(a),0)$ and $p'$ give $0\to\mathcal A\to P\to\mathcal C'\to0$: on each stalk $p'$ is surjective because $p$ is, and its kernel consists exactly of pairs $(i(a),0)$ since $i$ identifies $\mathcal A$ with $\ker p$. The maps $(1_{\mathcal A},q,u)$ form a morphism of short exact sequences from this pullback sequence to the original one, since $p\circ q=u\circ p'$ by the fiber-product equation.

source.place: Homology Section Tag 010I, pullback of an extension along its quotient map

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-ext-class-naturality] to the morphism of short exact sequences from step 1. Its left component is $1_{\mathcal A}$ and its right component is $u$, so $1_{\mathcal A}[1]\circ\delta(u^*\mathcal E)=\delta(\mathcal E)\circ u$. The identity on the left leaves the class unchanged.

source.place: Homology Section Tag 010I (homology-section-extensions, definition-ext-group and pullback construction), together with Derived Section Tag 06XP (derived-section-ext, definition-ext and Yoneda extension class)

proof.text: By [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-functoriality], the right side $\delta(\mathcal E)\circ u$ is the Yoneda composition named in the statement, equal to the contravariant Ext image $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(u,\mathcal A)(\delta)$. Thus the equality in step 2 is the claimed pullback-class formula.
